style: Stylised flat icon, NOT pixel art: a few broad, bold, simple shapes with confident gestures, like a modern app icon designed to be read at 24x24 pixels. Tonal variation instead of outlines: each colour in two or three tones (a light, a mid and a dark tone) laid down as large flat planes to show light and form; crisp clean edges. No outlines or strokes around shapes, no thin lines, no small details, minimal internal detail (at most one or two accent shapes inside a form), no text, no texture, no gradients finer than the broad tonal planes. Composition: ONE bold silhouette filling most of the canvas; never a diagram, no arrows between things, no scenes. Magenta is the brand colour, used for any subject without a natural colour of its own; other colours only where the subject needs them (green trees, brown wood, grey metal, yellow light). Shapes must stay readable on both light grey and dark grey backgrounds
style_pixel: Redback plugin icon style: composition is ONE simple bold silhouette as the main subject filling most of the grid, plus optionally ONE small badge icon (about 8x8 cells) overlapping the bottom-right corner to show the action or modifier; never a diagram, no arrows between things, no scenes, no multiple equal objects. NO outlines at all - no black or dark border drawn around shapes; every shape is defined only by solid blocks of flat colour and the contrast between neighbouring colours. Magenta is the brand colour: use it for the badge and for any subject without a natural colour of its own. Use a darker shade tone of the same colour (e.g. dark magenta) for depth or to separate overlapping parts, and a lighter highlight tone sparingly. Shapes must stay readable against both a light grey and a dark grey background, so avoid large white or pale areas on their own. Bold, chunky shapes with strokes at least 2 cells thick; no single-cell detail. Other colours only where the subject needs them (green trees, brown wood, grey metal, yellow light)
